verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents an official MCP server that lets users operate their account in natural language from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Claude Code. Through it, users can explore setup, diagnose tickets, audit knowledge bases, build, edit and deploy workflows, test tools, and run simulations, with example prompts and skill commands provided. Coach is also conversational and available in Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, and can implement improvements on request. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as documented, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.
